All 5 files are self-contained — no external images, only Google Fonts `@import` (allowed). The screenshots confirm the design matches the originals well: orange Chatori branding, cream/peach accent backgrounds, dark navy footer, restaurant cards with gradient placeholders + deal overlays, the WELCOME50 promo banner with dashed code box, the Chatori Pro comparison table on dark, and the bottom-sticky cart bar.

- `/app/site/restaurant.html`

- `/app/site/offers.html`
